translations.web: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
translations.bsb: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.
translations.kjv: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
